description: List Brazilian banks (COMPE code, ISPB, and name) from the central-bank registry, optionally filtered by name or code. Use to resolve a bank code from a boleto or PIX/TED transfer to the institution name, e.g. code 1 → Banco do Brasil, 260 → Nubank.

code.description: Exact COMPE bank code to look up, e.g. 341 for Itaú.

search.description: Filter by bank name substring (case-insensitive), e.g. "nubank" or "itau".

name: brasil_banks
title: Brasil Banks
